svg.title: Training and validation learning curves for a neural network
svg.desc: Two panels show root mean squared error over 420 epochs and a close view around the best validation epoch. Training error keeps falling after validation error reaches its minimum, which marks overfitting.
svg.title: Neural network learning curves

cc:Work.dc:title: Neural network learning curves
cc:Work.dc:description: Training and validation RMSE across a reproducible 420-epoch run.
